facts.text: Snow left Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) and Cedar Pass (7,060 ft) 41 to 43 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: left April 28; earlier seasons: June 14 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 5 (2025)

evidence.name: Cedar Pass
evidence.detail: left April 5; earlier seasons: May 22 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) and Cedar Pass (7,060 ft).

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: 6.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 45.8 in (2023), 37.0 in (2024), 45.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Cedar Pass
evidence.detail: 1.5 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 29.6 in (2023), 23.3 in (2024), 25.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 27 and April 27, carried from the melt-out dates at Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) and Cedar Pass (7,060 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: melted out April 28, 1,235 ft above the pass; points to March 7 to May 7

evidence.name: Cedar Pass
evidence.detail: melted out April 5, 925 ft above the pass; points to February 19 to April 17
